cases.name: archive-comment
cases.stricter: a non-empty archive comment is refused: it can carry trailing data or a second archive

cases.name: prepended-data
cases.stricter: data before the first member (zipfile's concat shift) is refused

cases.name: other-member-local-header-differs
cases.stricter: every member's local header must agree with the central directory (Python checks only the opened member)

cases.name: data-descriptor-size-mismatch
cases.stricter: a data descriptor that disagrees with the central directory is refused (Python ignores descriptors)

cases.name: bzip2-document
cases.stricter: only stored and DEFLATE members are accepted (Python also inflates bzip2/LZMA)

cases.name: latin1-declared
cases.stricter: a declared encoding other than UTF-8 is refused (expat would decode latin-1)

cases.name: non-ascii-element-name
cases.stricter: non-ASCII element and attribute names are refused

cases.name: nesting-300
cases.stricter: element nesting deeper than 256 is refused (Python's recursive walk fails near 1000)

cases.name: rebound-xml-prefix
cases.stricter: re-declaring the xml prefix is refused

cases.name: nul-in-member-name
cases.stricter: member names containing NUL are refused (Python truncates them)
